The '''Ripper''' was a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] produced for the civilian market by [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet Swoops and Speeders]] at some point prior to the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeder]] used by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during that period was based on the design of the Ripper.
